2608.06352.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
2608.06352.paper_summary: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool, whereas contrastive solver calibration targets a designated strong-pass/weak-fail relation; both operationalize a solver-relative learnable zone anchored in demonstrated solvability. Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated terminal tasks. Our ablations show that both strategies yield more effective supervision than authoring and validation alone or ordinary single-solver feedback. Models trained on the full collection achieve 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. The largest improvements over the corresponding base model reach 24.71 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 27.68 points on SWE-bench Pro, and 30.04 points on Doc2Repo. Together, these results support solver-relative learnability as a practical target for constructing effective and transferable agent training data.
2608.06352.paper_summary_zh: 訓練終端代理需要可執行且可驗證的任務，這些任務不僅僅是可解的，而是對學習來說適當具有挑戰性。可執行的驗證確立了可行性，但並不揭示任務在給定求解器設置下的行為。在本文中，我們介紹了 CalibForge，一個自動化的終端任務合成系統，利用經過驗證的求解器行為通過對抗性求解器校準來修訂候選任務。多求解器校準針對異質求解器池中的不一致，而對比求解器校準則針對指定的強通過/弱失敗關係；兩者都將可學習的求解器相關區域具體化，這一區域基於已展示的可解性。使用 CalibForge，我們構建了 5,431 個經校準的終端任務。我們的消融實驗顯示，這兩種策略提供的監督效果比單純的創作和驗證或普通的單一求解器反饋更為有效。基於完整數據集訓練的模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上達到 32.58% 和 47.57%。相對於相應的基準模型，最大的改進在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上達到 24.71 個百分點，在 SWE-bench Pro 上達到 27.68 個點，在 Doc2Repo 上達到 30.04 個點。總體而言，這些結果支持求解器相關的可學習性作為構建有效且可轉移的代理訓練數據的實際目標。
